summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of the CipherBox GSD workflow — 8 plans across 4 waves that harden IPNS verification fail-closed across Rust, TypeScript, and API layers, enforcing strict seq=1 first-publish, removing legacy acceptance paths, and adding CPU-cost recovery via a verify cache.
summary.outcome: Waves 1–3 completed (7/8 plans done, 251/251 Rust sdk-core tests and 159/159 API ipns specs passing). Wave 3 plan 60-06 was spawned but its result is not captured in the transcript. Wave 4 (60-08, non-autonomous operational cutover) remains pending human action.

repo: The canonical IPNS verify chokepoint was moved from crates/fuse/src/verify.rs into crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs so sdk/fuse/desktop share one implementation.
First-publish IPNS sequence was standardized from 0 to 1 across all 9 producers (FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, web); vault.test.ts had a stale 0n expectation that required updating.
crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was fully deleted in 60-04 once 60-01 moved the chokepoint and 60-04 re-pointed all imports.

60-01 added ciborium + cipherbox-core as dependencies to crates/api-client (CBOR Validity parsing for EOL/expiry enforcement) but the executor committed Cargo.toml without committing Cargo.lock, creating a latent --locked CI break.

The cross-language verify vectors at tests/vectors/ipns/verify.json are regenerated via npx tsx from a generator; legacy-absent and first-publish-skew cases were reclassified to expected_result: invalid.
Windows winfsp smoke site for 60-02 (first-publish seq=1) is CI-gated and not verifiable locally.
60-01 had to fold all 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms as a compile necessity even though that was scoped to 60-04, because removing the Legacy enum variant made the crate uncompilable.

code.finding: Was using VerifyError::Legacy which 60-01 removed; replaced with VerifyError::Invalid. Mid-run diagnostic falsely reported E0599 compile error from a stale snapshot — final build was clean.

workflow: Sequential gsd-executor subagents on the main working tree were chosen over worktree isolation because the harness has no reliable merge-back mechanism for isolation=worktree agents; this trades wall-clock time for correctness on a crypto-sensitive phase.

The gsd-helper commit tool has a known false-negative: it reports 'No staged files match any configured task' / commit_failed even when the commit actually lands. Always verify with git log rather than trusting the helper's return value.

Executors can append stray content to SUMMARY.md after their final commit (a footer self-check block), leaving uncommitted and factually stale content in the working tree — requires manual inspection and cleanup before the next wave.
Wave-level build/test gates between waves are critical for catching cross-plan integration issues (e.g., 60-01↔60-02 in fuse/metadata.rs, 60-02↔60-03 in sdk-core).
Jest output is noisy enough that a summary grep is needed to extract pass/fail counts when running as part of a gate check.

friction: gsd-helper commit tool false-negative: reports commit_failed even on success, requiring an extra git log verification step after every commit attempt.
60-01 executor left Cargo.lock uncommitted after adding ciborium + cipherbox-core deps to Cargo.toml, creating a latent --locked CI break that had to be caught and fixed manually between waves.
60-01 executor appended a stray, factually-wrong footer to 60-01-SUMMARY.md after its final commit (stated 'verify.rs FOUND' but 60-04 later deleted it); required manual revert.
False E0599 compile error diagnostic (VerifyError::Legacy in metadata.rs:619) from a mid-edit snapshot required manual cargo check to confirm the tree was actually green.
Jest output for API ipns specs buried the pass/fail summary in log noise, requiring a second extraction command.
open_items: Wave 3 plan 60-06 (API publish-path verify cache keyed by ipnsName+sequenceNumber+signatureV2-bytes, with measured cost recovery in docs/CAPACITY.md §1.5) was spawned but its outcome is not confirmed in the transcript.
Wave 4 plan 60-08 (D-01/D-12 operational cutover: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) is non-autonomous and requires human action before phase 60 can be marked complete.
Windows winfsp CI gate for 60-02 (first-publish seq=1 across all producers) was not locally verifiable and depends on CI to confirm.
